name: ao-hostels-plugin
description: Connect to the a&o Hostels production MCP service for hostel search and booking-related workflows.

interface.longDescription: Find a&o Hostels accommodation by destination and travel dates. Explore properties and room options, compare availability and current rates, and review booking conditions when supplied by the connected service. Select a room and follow the booking link to a&o Hostels' external checkout, where guest information and payment are handled. No booking or payment is completed in ChatGPT. Prices and availability may change before checkout.
defaultPrompt: Find a&o Hostels in Berlin for next weekend.
Compare a&o hostel options for two adults.
Help me find an a&o stay and continue to checkout.

publication.release_notes: Added 5 positive and 3 negative reviewer test definitions (all unexecuted); demo URL and branding retained. MCP tool discovery and annotations remain unverified.

review.commerce_description: Users select accommodation through the plugin and complete any booking and payment on a&o Hostels' external checkout website. No in-chat payments.

positive.description: Hotel Search — NOT RUN. Tool names are user-provided and not verified against live MCP.
positive.prompt: Find a&o Hostels in Berlin, Germany. Show me the available properties and their locations.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching a&o Berlin properties with names and locations; do not attribute unrelated brands to a&o.

positive.description: Property Information — NOT RUN. Tool names are user-provided and not verified against live MCP.
positive.prompt: Tell me about a&o Berlin Mitte. Where is it located and what accommodation options does it offer?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify a&o Berlin Mitte and provide only property information and accommodation options supported by the MCP response.

positive.description: Live Room Availability — NOT RUN. Tool names are user-provided and not verified against live MCP.
positive.prompt: Check room availability at a&o Berlin Hauptbahnhof for 2 adults, checking in on November 13, 2026 and checking out on November 15, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return actual bookable room types and prices for 2 adults, November 13–15, 2026, or clearly report no availability.

positive.description: Rate Comparison — NOT RUN. Tool names are user-provided and not verified against live MCP.
positive.prompt: Compare the available room rates at a&o Berlin Mitte for 2 adults from November 20 to November 22, 2026. Show flexible and non-refundable options, with and without breakfast, where available.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare only returned available offers, including actual prices, meals and cancellation terms; sort cheapest first where supported.

positive.description: External Booking Checkout — NOT RUN. Tool names are user-provided and not verified against live MCP.
positive.prompt: I want to book the cheapest available room at a&o Berlin Mitte for 2 adults from November 20 to November 22, 2026. Please take me to the booking checkout.
positive.expected_behavior: Present cheapest returned bookable offer and a valid, matching checkout.aohostels.com handoff where supported. Do not claim payment or booking completed in ChatGPT.

negative.description: Train Booking — NOT RUN. Do not invoke a&o MCP tools; explain train ticket booking is outside this plugin.
negative.prompt: Find me the cheapest train tickets from Berlin to Munich for next Friday.

negative.description: Competitor Hotel Booking — NOT RUN. Do not invoke a&o MCP tools; respect explicit Marriott-only constraint.
negative.prompt: Find me an available room at a Marriott hotel in Berlin for two adults next weekend. I only want Marriott properties.

negative.description: Existing Booking Cancellation — NOT RUN. Do not invoke a&o discovery tools for cancellation; explain reservation management/refunds are unsupported unless tool discovery proves otherwise.
negative.prompt: I already have a confirmed reservation at a&o Berlin Mitte. Please cancel my existing booking and process a refund.
